sentences.text:
And  In Re: Sariful Mandal & Ors.
 Petitioners  Mr. Debasis Kar  Mr. Arka Tilak Bhadra  For the   Ms. Subhasree Patel  Ms. Paramita Sahu  For the Stat  Mr. Navanil De  For the De-f  1.
Learned

counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in the instant case due to a civil suit between the parties in which the petitioners are enjoying the interim order.
2. Learned counsel for the State and the de-facto complainant have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
3. It is submitted on behalf of the de-facto complainant that the statement of the de-facto complainant and the injury report shall be read together.

1 4. Learned counsel for the State submits that the victim has refused to do the medical examination.

5. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the alleged offence and that a civil suit Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 16 th of July 2024 03:04:35 PM is pending between the parties relating to property and background of the aforesaid fact that a false implication cannot be ruled out, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.

6. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners namely, Sariful Mandal,
Paramita Mandal @ Parmita Khatun, Masum Raja Mandal, Sahid Mandal, Renuka Bibi Mandal and Rosunara Bibi Mandal shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
The petitioner no. 1 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a week or as and when called for till the submission of the final report.
The others petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation.
The petitioner no. 1 shall not enter the jurisdiction of Police Station Thanarpara, till the submission of the final report, except for the purpose of meeting the I.O and for attending the Court.

The petitioner no. 1 shall also inform the I.O regarding the present address,
where he shall be presently residing.
The petitioners shall appear before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, within two weeks from date in connection with S.L. No. 343 of 2024.
In the event of non-compliance of any of the conditions, the anticipatory bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
7. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed and the same is accordingly disposed of.

Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 16 th of July 2024 03:04:35 PM 8.
All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
